text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain can feel rewarding, but I should not let my average cost dictate when to trim; base each decision on expected return, risk, and the stock’s role in my portfolio.","My realized gains do not tell the whole story: track total account value and unrealized losses as well as sale proceeds, and judge progress across the portfolio.","Frequent trading and adding to positions should follow a clear plan; preserve diversification and cash flexibility instead of reacting to recent price moves or the urge to recover losses."]}
